title: Kit export from a library points the pads at the library's audio
description:
As a producer working from my library, I want to export a kit whose samples live in the library, so that the preset points at the library's own audio and loads on this machine.

```gherkin
Feature: Kit export from a library
  Background:
    Given a library holding the sample "marine-band/stems/Thunderer/drums.wav" with its analysis and saved clips
    And the score "flip.apr":
      """
      tempo 110
      key Bb
      clip brk = marine-band/stems/Thunderer/drums.wav loop-1
      kit b = slice brk by beats 0.5
      """

  Scenario: Pads reference the library's audio files
    When I export kit "b" from "flip.apr" with "--library" pointing at the library
    Then the export succeeds
    And every pad's sample file is the library's audio file for "marine-band/stems/Thunderer/drums.wav"
    And every pad's sample file exists

  Scenario: The sample's saved clip sets the region that is sliced
    When I export kit "b" from "flip.apr" with "--library" pointing at the library
    Then pad 1 starts where the saved clip "loop-1" starts

  Scenario: A sample the library does not hold is reported with the score line
    Given the score "flip.apr" names "missing/drums.wav" on line 3
    When I export kit "b" from "flip.apr" with "--library" pointing at the library
    Then the export fails with "flip.apr" and "missing/drums.wav"
```
